meta.title: Thai language pack
meta.description: Adds ไทย to Settings → General → Language using the native locale service. Covers the documented 0.2.2-rc.3 namespace snapshots and Codex Connect copy. Does not translate every third-party UI, plugin metadata, embedded editor, or generated message. Select Thai yourself; disabling removes the language and restores an available fallback. No network calls or DOM rewriting.
